items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Windows iSCSI allows unauthorized network feature bypass, potentially leading to storage compromise or lateral movement within trusted segments.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 的身份验证薄弱问题允许未经授权的网络功能绕过，可能导致受信任网段内的存储被攻陷或发生横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the SMB Client enables unauthenticated network RCE, exploiting a critical file-sharing protocol prevalent in enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: SMB Client 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现无需认证的远程网络代码执行，利用了企业网络中广泛存在的关键文件共享协议。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in .NET and Visual Studio allows network RCE and privilege escalation, threatening developer workstations and CI/CD pipeline integrity.
items.reason_zh: .NET 和 Visual Studio 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行与提权，威胁开发人员工作站及 CI/CD 流水线的完整性。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell enabling remote code execution over the network, posing a direct threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中存在严重的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可支持网络远程代码执行，对端点安全构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution vulnerability in the DHCP Server service that can compromise network infrastructure and allow unauthorized system access.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 服务中的远程代码执行漏洞可能破坏网络基础设施，并允许未经授权的系统访问。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the HTTP Print Provider allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via network-facing print services.
items.reason_zh: HTTP Print Provider 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络暴露的打印服务执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Microsoft Standard XPS parser enables remote code execution, leveraging a common document processing vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Standard XPS 解析器中的整数下溢漏洞可导致远程代码执行，利用了常见的文档处理途径。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows DirectShow affects media processing pipelines, allowing remote code execution through malicious media files.
items.reason_zh: Windows DirectShow 中的越界读取漏洞影响媒体处理管道，可通过恶意媒体文件实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows PDF parser facilitates remote code execution, targeting a widely used file format frequently exploited in phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows PDF 解析器中的整数上溢漏洞可导致远程代码执行，针对的是在钓鱼攻击中常被利用的广泛使用的文件格式。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Windows DNS service permits remote code execution, risking network resolution integrity and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及网络解析完整性并可能导致横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows remote code execution, directly threatening enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接威胁企业身份管理。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows RNDIS driver enables remote code execution, particularly impacting devices using USB networking or mobile tethering.
items.reason_zh: Windows RNDIS 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，特别影响使用 USB 网络或移动网络共享的设备。

items.reason_en: Path traversal weakness in Windows PowerShell allows privilege escalation over the network, compromising script execution environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 中的路径遍历弱点允许通过网络提权，破坏脚本执行环境。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 allows unauthorized remote code execution via the Event Logging Service, posing a critical risk for immediate system compromise without authentication.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 允许未经授权的远程代码执行（通过 Event Logging Service），构成无需认证即可立即攻陷系统的重大风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 enables network-based code execution through Media Foundation, frequently exploited via malicious media files or crafted URLs in user-facing applications.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过 Media Foundation 进行基于网络的代码执行，常在面向用户的应用程序中通过恶意媒体文件或构造的 URL 被利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.0 involves a stack overflow in Win32K allowing privilege escalation over the network, directly impacting desktop stability and security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.0 涉及 Win32K 中的栈溢出漏洞，允许通过网络提权，直接影响桌面稳定性和安全边界。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 permits unauthorized network code execution via the USB Mass Storage driver, creating a severe threat for endpoint devices handling external media.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 允许通过 USB Mass Storage 驱动程序进行未经授权的网络代码执行，对处理外部媒体的端点设备构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 allows remote code execution through Office Word, making it a prime target for phishing campaigns and document-based malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过 Office Word 进行远程代码执行，使其成为钓鱼攻击和基于文档的恶意软件投递的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows ALPC allows local privilege escalation. Marked as CISA KEV, indicating active exploitation in the wild and requiring immediate mitigation.
items.reason_zh: Windows ALPC 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地提权。该漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV，表明在实际环境中正被积极利用，需立即采取缓解措施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Client enables unauthorized network RCE. Widespread RDP deployment makes this a high-value target for initial access.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行。由于 RDP 部署广泛，该漏洞成为攻击者初始访问的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Schannel permits network RCE. Compromises the core TLS/crypto stack, impacting secure communications across the entire OS.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中的堆溢出漏洞允许网络远程代码执行。该漏洞破坏了核心 TLS/加密栈，影响整个操作系统的安全通信。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the NTFS driver allows local privilege escalation. Directly threatens the integrity and security of the primary Windows file system.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的越界读取漏洞允许本地提权，直接威胁主 Windows 文件系统的完整性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Critical network-based remote code execution in Windows Internet Connection Sharing due to a use-after-free flaw, posing severe risk to unpatched endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 由于释放后使用缺陷，Windows Internet Connection Sharing 中存在严重的基于网络的远程代码执行漏洞，对未打补丁的端点构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity network RCE in the Windows DHCP Server via use-after-free, enabling unauthorized attackers to compromise core network infrastructure services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于释放后使用（use-after-free）的高危网络远程代码执行漏洞，可导致未授权攻击者破坏核心网络基础设施服务。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows network-based remote code execution, directly threatening foundational directory resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在严重的释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞，可触发基于网络的远程代码执行，直接威胁基础目录解析服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the RPC Runtime enables network-based remote code execution, impacting a fundamental Windows communication subsystem widely targeted in active attacks.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中存在越界写入漏洞，可触发基于网络的远程代码执行，影响一个在活跃攻击中被广泛利用的基础 Windows 通信子系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office PowerPoint allows network-triggered code execution, making it highly attractive for phishing campaigns targeting end-users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office PowerPoint 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可触发网络驱动的代码执行，使其成为针对终端用户的钓鱼攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word facilitates network-based remote code execution, presenting significant risk through malicious document delivery.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，通过恶意文档投递构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Microsoft WebP Image Extension allows network-triggered code execution, exploiting a common image format used across web and client applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft WebP Image Extension 中存在整数溢出漏洞，可触发网络驱动的代码执行，该漏洞利用了 Web 及客户端应用中广泛使用的常见图像格式。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Imaging Component enables network-based remote code execution, affecting core image processing routines used system-wide.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可触发基于网络的远程代码执行，影响系统全局使用的核心图像处理例程。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution flaw in Windows Remote Desktop Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network without authentication, posing an immediate threat to exposed RDP endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 中存在严重的远程代码执行漏洞，允许未授权攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下通过网络执行任意代码，对已暴露的 RDP 端点构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: A severe heap-based buffer overflow in the NTFS file system enables unauthorized network-based code execution, potentially allowing attackers to compromise entire systems through maliciously crafted disk images or shared volumes.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 文件系统中存在严重的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未授权的网络代码执行，攻击者可能借此通过精心构造的恶意磁盘映像或共享卷入侵整个系统。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in Windows Media Foundation permits unauthorized remote code execution over the network, making it highly exploitable via malicious media files or streaming payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，极易通过恶意媒体文件或流媒体有效载荷进行利用。

items.reason_en: A critical integer underflow in the UxTheme library allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network, impacting core UI rendering and enabling widespread exploitation through themed applications.
items.reason_zh: UxTheme 库中存在严重的整数下溢漏洞，可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，影响核心 UI 渲染，并可通过主题应用实现广泛利用。

items.reason_en: This heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft DirectMusic grants unauthorized remote code execution over the network, targeting legacy audio processing components that remain active on many enterprise workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft DirectMusic 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，该漏洞针对许多企业工作站上仍保留运行的遗留音频处理组件。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows Kernel enables remote network-based privilege escalation, directly threatening endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中存在释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞，可触发基于网络的远程权限提升，直接威胁终端完整性。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible use-after-free in Print Spooler Components allows attackers to escalate privileges without requiring local user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 组件中存在可网络访问的释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞，允许攻击者在无需本地用户交互的情况下实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Visual Studio permits remote code execution via specially crafted network traffic targeting development environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过针对开发环境的精心构造网络流量实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remote heap overflow in Windows Media Foundation can lead to arbitrary code execution when processing malicious media payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中存在远程堆溢出漏洞，在处理恶意媒体有效载荷时可能导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET allows unauthorized local code execution, posing a significant risk to Windows workstations and servers relying on managed frameworks.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中存在越界写入漏洞，可导致未授权的本地代码执行，对依赖托管框架的 Windows 工作站和服务器构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office enables local code execution via malicious documents, creating a high-value target for targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过恶意文档实现本地代码执行，使其成为定向钓鱼攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the iSCSI Target Service enables remote code execution over the network. Its critical 9.8 CVSS score highlights an immediate exploitation risk for enterprise storage networks.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI Target Service 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。其高达 9.8 的 CVSS 评分突显了企业存储网络面临的即时利用风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows SMB Server allows remote code execution over the network. SMB is a primary lateral movement vector, making this highly dangerous for domain environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。由于 SMB 是主要的横向移动途径，该漏洞对域环境极具危险性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over the network. Compromising RDP directly threatens remote administration infrastructure and user endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。RDP 遭入侵将直接威胁远程管理基础设施及用户终端。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows privilege escalation over the network. DNS is foundational to enterprise networking, amplifying the impact of remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞，可导致网络权限提升。作为企业网络的基础设施，该漏洞会显著放大远程利用的影响。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution over an adjacent network. DHCP failures or compromise disrupt core network connectivity and security policies.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致相邻网络远程代码执行。DHCP 故障或遭入侵将破坏核心网络连接与安全策略。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Win32K allows local privilege escalation with a notably high EPSS score (0.0261). This indicates strong real-world exploitability for desktop users interacting with graphical subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K 中存在释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，且具备显著的 EPSS 评分（0.0261）。这表明与图形子系统交互的桌面用户在实际环境中面临极高的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this UAF in the WinSock driver enables local privilege escalation, posing an immediate threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: 该 WinSock 驱动程序中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞已在野外被活跃利用（列入 CISA KEV），可导致本地权限提升，对终端安全构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: A critical UAF in Windows Deployment Services allows unauthenticated remote code execution during network provisioning, severely impacting enterprise deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中存在严重的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可在网络配置期间触发未认证的远程代码执行，严重破坏企业部署流程。

items.reason_en: UAF in Active Directory Certificate Services can lead to remote code execution, directly compromising enterprise PKI infrastructure and trust hierarchies.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏企业 PKI 基础设施及信任层级。

items.reason_en: UAF in Windows Schannel impacts core TLS/SSL handling, potentially enabling man-in-the-middle attacks or local privilege escalation through cryptographic failures.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，影响核心 TLS/SSL 处理机制，可能因加密缺陷导致中间人攻击或本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows HTTP.sys allows local privilege escalation; this network stack component is frequently targeted for post-exploitation lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows HTTP.sys 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。该网络协议栈组件常被攻击者利用以实现利用后的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Win32K enables local privilege escalation through the graphics subsystem, a common attack vector for kernel-level code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过图形子系统实现本地权限提升，此为常见的内核级代码执行攻击途径。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Remote Desktop Services permits local privilege escalation, directly impacting secure remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接影响安全远程管理流程。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows unauthenticated remote code execution over a network, posing a significant threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，对终端安全构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection in Dell ThinOS 10 allows immediate remote code execution with minimal prerequisites, posing a severe threat to enterprise thin-client deployments.
items.reason_zh: Dell ThinOS 10 中的未授权操作系统命令注入漏洞可在极少前提条件下立即实现远程代码执行，对企业瘦客户端部署构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Critical kernel-level buffer overflow in the Linux SMB client ACL parsing logic enables local privilege escalation or system instability when mounting untrusted shares.
items.reason_zh: Linux SMB 客户端 ACL 解析逻辑中存在关键的内核级缓冲区溢出漏洞，在挂载不受信任的共享时可能导致本地权限提升或系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Qt's XML module can cause stack exhaustion and application crashes, impacting desktop software relying on XML parsing.
items.reason_zh: Qt 的 XML 模块中存在不受控制的递归问题，可能导致栈耗尽和应用程序崩溃，影响依赖 XML 解析的桌面软件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in xdgmime allows local attackers to crash applications or potentially achieve code execution by manipulating MIME magic files.
items.reason_zh: xdgmime 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地攻击者通过操纵 MIME magic 文件导致应用程序崩溃或潜在地实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android allows authorized attackers to perform network spoofing, exposing mobile enterprise communication clients to man-in-the-middle risks.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已授权攻击者进行网络欺骗，使移动企业通信客户端面临中间人攻击风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Microsoft Teams for Android allows unauthorized file access and potential remote code execution on mobile devices, compromising user data and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权的文件访问及移动设备上的潜在远程代码执行，危及用户数据和会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Remote heap-based buffer overflow in Samsung's JPEG decoder library allows arbitrary code execution via maliciously crafted image files, affecting millions of mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung JPEG 解码库中的远程基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意构造的图像文件实现任意代码执行，影响数百万台移动设备。

items.reason_en: Flawed authorization controls in the Lenovo Health Android application expose sensitive biometric and medical data to unauthorized local users on compromised devices.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo Health Android 应用中的缺陷授权控制机制会将敏感的生物特征与医疗数据暴露给受损设备上未授权的本地用户。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Samsung's DualDAR component enables local privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung DualDAR 组件中的释放后使用漏洞可使拥有本地特权的攻击者在移动设备上以 root 权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Samsung's libmdnie.so allows local attackers to escalate to system server privileges, compromising device integrity.
items.reason_zh: Samsung libmdnie.so 中的越界写入漏洞允许本地攻击者提升至系统服务器权限，破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in ArduinoBLE's ATT layer allows remote BLE clients to corrupt memory, compromising connected embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: ArduinoBLE 的 ATT 层中缺失边界检查漏洞，允许远程 BLE 客户端破坏内存，危及已连接的嵌入式设备。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in D-Link router firmware enables local network attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted DHCP packets.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 路由器固件中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地网络攻击者通过构造的 DHCP 数据包执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded bootloader credentials in Carecam IP cameras permit physical attackers to flash modified firmware, undermining device integrity and network segmentation strategies.
items.reason_zh: Carecam IP 摄像头中的硬编码引导加载程序凭据允许物理攻击者刷入修改后的固件，破坏设备完整性和网络分段策略。

items.reason_en: Missing brute-force protection on smart video intercoms enables unauthenticated account takeover through credential stuffing attacks.
items.reason_zh: 智能视频对讲机中缺失暴力破解防护机制，可通过凭证填充攻击实现未授权账户接管。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the WeenyGenius computer lab management system allows network attackers to spoof endpoints and disrupt classroom operations.
items.reason_zh: WeenyGenius 计算机实验室管理系统中缺失身份验证机制，允许网络攻击者伪造终端并干扰课堂运营。

items.reason_en: Use of an insecure protocol in WeenyGenius exposes transmitted data to interception and enables replay attacks by unauthenticated network adversaries.
items.reason_zh: WeenyGenius 中使用不安全的协议会导致传输数据面临被拦截的风险，并使未授权的网络攻击者能够实施重放攻击。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file write in Wavlink router firmware enables complete device takeover, persistence installation, and network pivoting without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Wavlink 路由器固件中的未授权任意文件写入漏洞可在无需凭据的情况下实现设备完全接管、持久化安装及网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: Adjacent network OS command injection via crafted UDP packets in TP-Link Deco mesh routers allows attackers to gain root-level control over home and small business networks.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Deco 网状网络路由器中通过构造的 UDP 数据包实现的相邻网络操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者获取家庭和小型企业网络的 root 级控制权。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Nintendo Switch wireless networking enables remote code execution via crafted packets from nearby attackers.
items.reason_zh: Nintendo Switch 无线网络中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许附近攻击者通过构造的数据包实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Dell ThinOS allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands, compromising diskless client infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Dell ThinOS 中的命令注入漏洞允许未授权的相邻攻击者执行任意操作系统命令，危及无盘客户端基础设施。

items.reason_en: A critical authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C allows attackers to elevate privileges network-wide, fundamentally breaking identity management controls.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD B2C 中的关键授权绕过漏洞允许攻击者在整个网络范围内提升权限，从根本上破坏了身份管理控制机制。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language exposes core functions to unauthorized network actors, risking data exfiltration and service abuse.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 中缺失身份验证机制会将核心功能暴露给未授权的网络实体，面临数据外泄和服务滥用风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the Spring Cloud Azure framework enables network-level privilege escalation, threatening hybrid cloud deployments.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure 框架中的身份验证不当漏洞可实现网络级权限提升，威胁混合云部署环境。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics 365 enables unauthenticated network RCE, posing direct threats to cloud-hosted business applications and tenant data.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可实现未授权的网络远程代码执行，直接威胁云端托管的业务应用及租户数据。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently protected credentials in Azure CycleCloud lead to information disclosure. Exposes sensitive cloud orchestration configurations and potential secrets.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中凭据保护不足导致信息泄露，暴露敏感的云编排配置及潜在密钥。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables network code execution. Directly threatens enterprise SaaS applications and underlying business logic workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的代码注入漏洞可实现网络代码执行，直接威胁企业 SaaS 应用及底层业务逻辑工作流。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Hyper-V allows local code execution. Impacts the foundational virtualization layer heavily utilized in modern cloud and hybrid environments.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的不可信指针解引用漏洞允许本地代码执行，严重影响现代云和混合环境中广泛使用的底层虚拟化层。

items.reason_en: Critical missing authorization in Microsoft Entra ID allows privilege escalation across cloud tenants, risking widespread identity compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中关键的授权缺失漏洞允许跨云租户提升权限，面临大规模身份泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Entra ID via alternate channels enables unauthorized administrative access to cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中通过备用通道实现的认证绕过漏洞可致使未授权管理员访问云资源。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure Cosmos DB allows spoofing and unauthorized data manipulation through user-controlled cryptographic keys.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的权限绕过漏洞允许攻击者利用用户控制的加密密钥实施伪造及未授权的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Permissive cross-domain policy in Azure Arc exposes cloud-managed infrastructure to lateral movement and privilege escalation attacks.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中过于宽松的跨域策略使云管理基础设施易受横向移动与权限提升攻击。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc enables unauthorized network privilege escalation, directly compromising hybrid cloud management infrastructure and identity boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的授权配置错误可导致未授权的网络权限提升，直接危及混合云管理基础设施与身份边界安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized cluster privilege escalation, threatening containerized workload isolation and orchestration security.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺失的认证机制可导致未授权的集群权限提升，危及容器化工作负载隔离性与编排安全。

items.reason_en: DNS zone management flaws in Plesk allow authenticated administrators to disclose local files and escalate privileges, impacting widespread web hosting and control panel environments.
items.reason_zh: Plesk 的 DNS 区域管理缺陷可使已认证管理员泄露本地文件并提权，广泛影响 Web 托管与控制面板环境。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Entra Connect Sync allows local privilege escalation. Exploiting this flaw compromises identity synchronization pipelines between on-premises directories and cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可导致本地权限提升；利用该漏洞将破坏本地目录与云租户间的身份同步链路。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows unauthorized privilege escalation within cloud workload orchestration environments, risking multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失的鉴权机制可导致云工作负载编排环境内的未授权提权，危及多租户隔离安全。

items.reason_en: XSS in Azure Storage Explorer enables session hijacking and data exfiltration from cloud storage management interfaces accessed by developers and administrators.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中的跨站脚本(XSS)漏洞可导致会话劫持与数据外泄，威胁开发人员和管理员使用的云存储管理界面。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted reports, threatening business intelligence ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中输入验证缺陷可使已认证攻击者通过构造报表执行任意代码，危及商业智能生态安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in Dynamics 365 permits remote code execution, risking sensitive CRM data and extending lateral movement within cloud-hosted business applications.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中的反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及敏感 CRM 数据并扩大云托管业务应用内的横向移动范围。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID grants unauthenticated attackers remote code execution over the network, risking complete identity provider compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中存在的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可使未认证攻击者在网络层面实现远程代码执行，危及身份提供者的整体安全。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Active Directory allows authorized users to escalate privileges and potentially access internal cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可使已授权用户提权并潜在访问内部云资源。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online enables unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges and interact with internal mail infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可使未认证攻击者提权并与内部邮件基础设施交互。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Azure Service Bus permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, threatening message queue reliability and tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可使已认证攻击者远程执行任意代码，危及消息队列可靠性与租户隔离安全。

items.reason_en: OIDC federation misconfiguration in Cloud Foundry UAA allows attackers to escalate privileges and obtain administrative scopes despite explicit operator whitelist restrictions.
items.reason_zh: Cloud Foundry UAA 中的 OIDC 联邦配置错误可使攻击者突破明确的运营方白名单限制，实现提权并获取管理员权限范围。

items.reason_en: Malicious QCOW disk headers bypass format restrictions in OpenStack Nova, triggering arbitrary command execution via qemu-img during virtual machine instance resizing operations.
items.reason_zh: 恶意的 QCOW 磁盘头可绕过 OpenStack Nova 的格式限制，在虚拟机实例扩容/缩容过程中通过 qemu-img 触发任意命令执行。

items.reason_en: SSRF validation bypass in non-production builds of OpenMAIC allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive cloud instance metadata and credentials.
items.reason_zh: OpenMAIC 非生产构建版本中的服务器端请求伪造验证绕过漏洞可使未认证攻击者访问敏感的云实例元数据与凭证。

items.reason_en: An extremely high-severity use-after-free in the NFS ONCRPC XDR Driver permits remote code execution over the network, destabilizing network storage infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NFS ONCRPC XDR 驱动中存在极高危的释放后使用漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，破坏网络存储基础设施稳定性。

items.reason_en: Another critical UAF in the same driver family presents an immediate remote exploitation vector for network-attached storage environments.
items.reason_zh: 同系列驱动中的另一处关键释放后使用漏洞为网络附加存储环境提供了即时的远程利用途径。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver allows remote code execution via crafted multicast packets, impacting enterprise networking.
items.reason_zh: 可靠多播传输驱动中的释放后使用漏洞可通过构造的多播数据包实现远程代码执行，波及企业级网络架构。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS allows unauthenticated network access, compromising critical routing and remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 中的远程代码执行漏洞允许未认证的网络访问，危及关键路由与远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS enables unauthenticated network RCE, threatening name resolution services essential for daily network operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证的网络远程代码执行，危及支撑日常网络运行的核心名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server allows unauthenticated network RCE, risking IP address management and broader network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未认证的网络远程代码执行，危及 IP 地址管理与整体网络连通性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in OpenSSH for Windows enables unauthenticated network RCE, compromising secure remote administration and automation capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证的网络远程代码执行，危及安全远程管理与自动化能力。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Remote Access Connection Manager permits network RCE, weakening remote connection handling and perimeter defense mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 远程访问连接管理器中的整数下溢漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，削弱远程连接处理与边界防御机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network via the DHCP Server, disrupting IP allocation and enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分 8.8 的漏洞可使已认证攻击者通过 DHCP 服务器执行网络代码，破坏 IP 分配并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 enables unauthorized denial of service against LDAP services, which can block directory authentication and disrupt enterprise network operations.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分 7.5 的漏洞可对 LDAP 服务实施未授权的拒绝服务攻击，阻断目录认证并扰乱企业网络运行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.1 involves a use-after-free in NDIS allowing privilege escalation over the network, compromising core network driver security and system integrity.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分 7.1 的漏洞涉及 NDIS 驱动中的释放后使用，可导致网络权限提升，危及核心网络驱动安全与系统完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 allows unauthorized denial of service via BranchCache, potentially degrading content delivery networks and internal caching performance.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分 7.5 的漏洞可通过 BranchCache 实施未授权的拒绝服务攻击，可能导致内容分发网络及内部缓存性能下降。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows network RCE. DNS infrastructure is frequently leveraged for lateral movement and reconnaissance in compromised networks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。DNS基础设施常被用于已入侵网络中的横向移动和侦察活动。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Active Directory Certificate Services enables local privilege escalation. Compromises the PKI trust chain and could allow rogue certificate issuance.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services中的堆溢出漏洞可实现本地权限提升。该漏洞破坏了PKI信任链，可能导致恶意证书签发。

items.reason_en: Race condition in DNS Server allows network RCE. Highlights critical synchronization flaws in network resolution services that attackers can exploit remotely.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的竞争条件漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。凸显了网络解析服务中攻击者可远程利用的关键同步缺陷。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in WatchGuard Fireware OS iked daemon allows unauthenticated remote code execution, crippling enterprise perimeter security.
items.reason_zh: WatchGuard Fireware OS的iked守护进程存在堆溢出漏洞，允许未认证远程代码执行，严重破坏企业边界安全。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening critical network name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server中的竞争条件漏洞可启用远程代码执行，威胁关键的网络名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Suricata's IP defragmentation tracker flaw allows protocol family mismatches, potentially causing detection engine crashes or evasion.
items.reason_zh: Suricata的IP分片重组跟踪器缺陷可导致协议族不匹配，可能引发检测引擎崩溃或导致攻击者绕过检测。

items.reason_en: Insufficient bounds checking in Suricata's DNP3 reassembly triggers memory exhaustion denial-of-service, disrupting industrial network monitoring and IDS/IPS deployments.
items.reason_zh: Suricata的DNP3重组模块缺乏足够的边界检查，会触发内存耗尽型拒绝服务，破坏工业网络监控及IDS/IPS部署。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in strongSwan's IKEv2 rekeying mechanism can lead to remote code execution or service crashes, weakening VPN gateway resilience and tunnel stability.
items.reason_zh: strongSwan的IKEv2重新密钥机制存在释放后使用漏洞，可能导致远程代码执行或服务崩溃，削弱VPN网关的韧性与隧道稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical UAF in Microsoft QUIC implementation allows unauthenticated remote code execution over UDP networks, compromising modern HTTP/3 and secure transport layers.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC实现中存在严重的UAF漏洞，允许通过UDP网络进行未认证远程代码执行，危及现代HTTP/3与安全传输层。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS compromises routing and remote access gateways, exposing internal corporate networks to direct external exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS中的远程代码执行漏洞会破坏路由与远程访问网关，使企业内部网络直接暴露于外部攻击之下。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver enables adjacent network code execution via multicast traffic, affecting industrial and enterprise broadcast systems.
items.reason_zh: Reliable Multicast Transport Driver中的堆溢出漏洞可通过组播流量实现相邻网络代码执行，影响工业与企业广播系统。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger memory corruption and achieve remote code execution, destabilizing critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的竞争条件漏洞允许未认证攻击者触发内存损坏并实现远程代码执行，破坏关键名称解析服务的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection in WAVLINK routers allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root, fully compromising home and small business networks.
items.reason_zh: WAVLINK路由器存在未认证操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者以root权限执行任意命令，完全攻破家庭与小型企业网络。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 type confusion in Suricata can cause crashes during traffic processing, degrading intrusion detection capabilities and enabling evasion techniques.
items.reason_zh: Suricata中的HTTP/2类型混淆漏洞可在流量处理期间引发崩溃，降低入侵检测能力并助长规避技术。

items.reason_en: Unbounded state growth in Suricata's IKEv2 parser leads to excessive memory consumption and denial of service under crafted UDP traffic conditions.
items.reason_zh: Suricata的IKEv2解析器存在无界状态增长问题，在构造的UDP流量条件下会导致过度内存消耗与拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Download of unsigned code without integrity checks in Dell SCG appliances permits unauthenticated remote attackers to deploy and execute malicious payloads directly on storage controllers.
items.reason_zh: Dell SCG设备在未进行完整性校验的情况下下载未签名代码，允许未认证远程攻击者在存储控制器上直接部署并执行恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: SAML response tampering vulnerability in HPE IceWall products enables identity spoofing and unauthorized access to federated enterprise authentication and single sign-on systems.
items.reason_zh: HPE IceWall产品存在SAML响应篡改漏洞，可实现身份伪造并未经授权访问联邦企业认证与单点登录系统。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, this MikroTik RouterOS flaw allows privilege escalation by exploiting SSH login argument handling, directly impacting network infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已被列入CISA KEV目录，此MikroTik RouterOS缺陷可通过利用SSH登录参数处理实现权限提升，直接影响网络基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Also in CISA KEV, this MikroTik vulnerability allows unauthenticated clients to exploit uninitialized kernel memory during UDP testing, leading to potential data leakage or crashes.
items.reason_zh: 同样被列入CISA KEV目录，此MikroTik漏洞允许未认证客户端在UDP测试期间利用未初始化的内核内存，可能导致数据泄露或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Authenticated attackers can exploit a web interface flaw in HPE ClearPass Policy Manager to achieve remote code execution on network access control systems.
items.reason_zh: 已认证攻击者可利用HPE ClearPass Policy Manager的Web界面缺陷，在网络访问控制系统上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Infinite loop in strongSwan's x509 attribute certificate parser can trigger denial-of-service conditions in VPN deployments processing malicious certificates.
items.reason_zh: strongSwan的x509属性证书解析器存在无限循环漏洞，在处理恶意证书的VPN部署中可触发拒绝服务条件。

items.reason_en: High-severity vulnerability in Advantech WISE-6610 industrial gateways could allow remote exploitation, disrupting manufacturing and OT operations.
items.reason_zh: Advantech WISE-6610工业网关存在高危漏洞，可能被远程利用，从而扰乱制造与OT作业。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authentication algorithm implementation in Schneider Electric PLCs compromises system confidentiality and integrity, presenting direct operational technology safety and availability hazards.
items.reason_zh: Schneider Electric PLCs中身份验证算法实现错误会损害系统机密性与完整性，带来直接的运营技术安全与可用性风险。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Schneider Electric systems allows authenticated SSH users to escalate to root and execute administrative functions, jeopardizing industrial control operations.
items.reason_zh: Schneider Electric系统中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证的SSH用户提权至root并执行管理功能，危及工业控制作业。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in iDirect VSAT terminals running outdated firmware enables attackers to gain root access on critical satellite communication hardware.
items.reason_zh: 运行过时固件的iDirect VSAT终端存在本地权限提升漏洞，使攻击者能够获取关键卫星通信硬件的root访问权限。

items.reason_en: Exposed device configuration containing MD5 password hashes in iDirect terminals allows credential cracking and unauthorized administrative access to remote infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: iDirect终端中暴露的包含MD5密码哈希的设备配置文件允许凭证破解，并导致对远程基础设施的未授权管理访问。

items.reason_en: Bypasses driver verification mechanisms to allow arbitrary code execution upon uploading malicious hardware packages, threatening operational technology environments requiring physical interaction.
items.reason_zh: 绕过驱动程序验证机制，允许在上传恶意硬件包时执行任意代码，威胁需物理交互的运营技术环境。

items.reason_en: Weak cryptographic hashing of AVEVA PIMBoards project files enables offline brute-forcing of native passwords, facilitating rapid escalation to administrator privileges in industrial engineering workflows.
items.reason_zh: AVEVA PIMBoards项目文件的弱加密哈希处理使得离线暴力破解原生密码成为可能，加速了工业工程工作流中向管理员权限的提权。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the Axolotl AI Cloud pipeline bypasses security guards via malicious Hugging Face models, threatening AI application supply chains.
items.reason_zh: Axolotl AI Cloud流水线中的远程代码执行漏洞可通过恶意Hugging Face模型绕过安全守卫，威胁AI应用供应链。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core creates severe denial-of-service conditions for web applications under heavy load.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中未加限制的资源分配会在高负载下为Web应用造成严重的拒绝服务状况。

items.reason_en: Capture-replay authentication bypass in MSAL Node.js enables token spoofing, undermining secure web application login flows.
items.reason_zh: MSAL Node.js 中的捕获重放身份验证绕过可导致令牌伪造，破坏安全的 Web 应用登录流程。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network RCE, directly impacting web collaboration platforms and internal intranet services.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的授权缺失可导致未认证的远程网络代码执行（RCE），直接影响 Web 协作平台和内部内网服务。

items.reason_en: Execution with unnecessary privileges in SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, increasing the blast radius of compromised web applications.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中以非必要特权运行允许网络提权，扩大被攻陷 Web 应用的影响范围。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables network spoofing and phishing, facilitating credential theft and social engineering attacks against end users.

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in URL Moniker enables network-based code execution, frequently triggered by malicious links or embedded objects in web browsers.
items.reason_zh: URL Moniker 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的堆溢出漏洞可启用基于网络的代码执行，通常由 Web 浏览器中的恶意链接或嵌入对象触发。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 allows remote code execution via JScript type conversion flaws, making it highly exploitable in legacy web applications and ActiveX environments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.1 的 JScript 类型转换缺陷可导致远程代码执行，在遗留 Web 应用和 ActiveX 环境中极易被利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.1 heap overflow in Standard XPS affects document rendering engines commonly used in web-based print and preview functionalities.
items.reason_zh: Standard XPS 中 CVSS 评分为 7.1 的堆溢出漏洞影响常用于基于 Web 的打印和预览功能的文档渲染引擎。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Visual Studio Code allows network security bypass. Enables attackers to pivot from development environments to internal network resources.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可导致网络安全绕过，使攻击者能够从开发环境横向移动至内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in SharePoint permits network code execution. Directly affects widely deployed web-based collaboration platforms and document management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的访问控制不当漏洞允许网络代码执行，直接影响广泛部署的基于 Web 的协作平台和文档管理系统。

items.reason_en: Failing open in Visual Studio Code allows network security bypass. Undermines built-in authentication and authorization mechanisms in popular developer tools.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的失败时开放漏洞可导致网络安全绕过，削弱流行开发工具中内置的身份验证与授权机制。

items.reason_en: Critical OS command injection in Adobe Campaign Classic enables full system takeover via unsanitized input in marketing automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Campaign Classic 中的严重操作系统命令注入漏洞可通过营销自动化工作流中的未过滤输入实现完全的系统接管。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in knowns-dev proxy endpoint allows attackers to read or modify arbitrary host files outside intended project roots.
items.reason_zh: knowns-dev 代理端点中的路径遍历漏洞可使攻击者读取或修改预期项目根目录之外的任意主机文件。

items.reason_en: Conditional SAML signature verification in passport-saml-encrypted allows complete authentication bypass using forged unsigned responses.
items.reason_zh: passport-saml-encrypted 中的条件性 SAML 签名验证缺陷可利用伪造的无签名响应实现完全的身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: Overly permissive TailwindCSS configuration in Hugo static sites bypasses security sandboxing, enabling arbitrary script execution during builds.
items.reason_zh: Hugo 静态网站中过于宽松的 TailwindCSS 配置会绕过安全沙箱，导致构建期间可执行任意脚本。

items.reason_en: SPIP CMS remote code execution via flawed SQL table resolution permits nonce-authenticated attackers to inject malicious jobs, severely impacting legacy content management deployments.
items.reason_zh: 通过有缺陷的 SQL 表解析，SPIP CMS 存在远程代码执行漏洞，允许经过 nonce 认证的攻击者注入恶意任务，严重影响遗留内容管理系统的部署。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Avis Vérifiés WooCommerce plugin directly exposes underlying database structures, affecting numerous e-commerce storefronts without requiring prior access.
items.reason_zh: Avis Vérifiés WooCommerce 插件中的未认证 SQL 注入漏洞可直接暴露底层数据库结构，影响众多电商商店，且无需预先访问权限。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Everest Forms enables immediate remote code execution, exploiting common deserialization sinks prevalent in WordPress ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Everest Forms 中的未认证 PHP 对象注入漏洞可利用 WordPress 生态系统中普遍存在的常见反序列化入口实现即时远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Authentication bypasses directly undermine web platform access controls and data confidentiality.

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Microsoft Exchange Server allows privilege escalation over the network. Replay attacks against email gateways can lead to unauthorized administrative access and message interception.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中通过捕获重放实现的身份验证绕过可导致网络提权。针对邮件网关的重放攻击可能导致未授权的管理员访问及消息拦截。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution through maliciously crafted web requests, threatening collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可通过精心构造的恶意 Web 请求实现远程代码执行，威胁协作平台安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely via email processing, disrupting enterprise communication channels.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过邮件处理远程执行代码，破坏企业通信渠道。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Copilot exposes AI-assisted development tools to local environment compromise, risking developer workstations and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot 中的命令注入漏洞使 AI 辅助开发工具面临本地环境沦陷风险，危及开发者工作站及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates phishing and credential theft through manipulated web interfaces, targeting end-users and helpdesk portals.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过篡改 Web 界面便于网络钓鱼和凭证窃取，主要针对终端用户和帮助台门户。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, exploiting browser rendering engine vulnerabilities.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium) 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可利用浏览器渲染引擎缺陷实现网络未认证远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, compromising enterprise document management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行任意代码，破坏企业文档管理安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated blind SQL injection in SPIP's public sitemap endpoint allows attackers to extract database contents without proper input sanitization.

items.reason_en: Unsafe serialization of DOM nodes in Angular server-side rendering can lead to cross-site scripting or information disclosure in modern web applications.
items.reason_zh: Angular 服务端渲染中对 DOM 节点的不安全序列化可能导致现代 Web 应用出现跨站脚本（XSS）或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Publicly shared MCP endpoints in IBM Langflow lack proper session isolation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary flows and manipulate sensitive chat sessions.

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly endangering database confidentiality and integrity.

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, threatening critical data infrastructure and backend services.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在CVSS评分为8.8的堆溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，威胁关键数据基础设施与后端服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 represents another critical SQL Server memory corruption flaw that could allow attackers to bypass database security controls and execute arbitrary commands.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8代表另一项关键的SQL Server内存损坏漏洞，攻击者可借此绕过数据库安全控制并执行任意命令。

items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在CVSS评分为8.8的使用后释放漏洞，对远程代码执行构成重大风险，可能导致数据库服务器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in SQL Server enables network privilege escalation. As a critical database engine, successful exploitation grants full control over stored data and server processes.

items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的远程堆溢出漏洞允许未认证攻击者在托管敏感数据的数据库服务器上直接执行代码。

items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中的SQL注入允许授权用户提权并操纵底层数据结构，面临严重数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Improper channel restriction in Azure SQL Managed Instance enables unauthorized privilege escalation by bypassing intended communication boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Managed Instance中的通道限制不当，通过绕过预期的通信边界实现未授权提权。

items.reason_en: Unsafe JSON deserialization in Jackson-databind binds raw strings to complex XMLGregorianCalendar fields, potentially triggering runtime exceptions or logic bypasses in Java middleware.

items.reason_en: Lenient HTTP/2 path pseudo-header validation in gRPC-Go bypasses server authorization, granting unauthorized access to protected microservice endpoints and internal APIs.
items.reason_zh: gRPC-Go中对HTTP/2路径伪头的验证过于宽松，会绕过服务器授权，授予对受保护微服务端点与内部API的未授权访问。

items.reason_zh: Jackson Databind中不安全的多态类型验证允许反序列化任意数组类型，通过恶意构造的序列化载荷可实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network-based privilege escalation, compromising critical email infrastructure and potentially leading to full server takeover.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中缺失授权检查允许基于网络的权限提升，危及关键电子邮件基础设施，并可能导致服务器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Critical cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing and credential theft, severely impacting enterprise communication security.

items.reason_zh: melange/apko打包工具中哈希验证不完整，允许被篡改的软件包通过验证，从而破坏软件供应链完整性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect memory free operation in PCRE2 JIT matcher can crash applications processing crafted regular expressions, undermining foundational text processing library stability across diverse software stacks.
items.reason_zh: PCRE2 JIT匹配器中存在错误的内存释放操作，处理特制正则表达式时可能导致应用程序崩溃，破坏跨多种软件栈的基础文本处理库稳定性。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in the .NET Framework allows local privilege escalation. Path manipulation flaws in widely deployed frameworks can destabilize enterprise applications and bypass sandboxing.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中存在相对路径遍历漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。广泛部署的框架中的路径操纵缺陷可能使企业应用程序失稳并绕过沙箱机制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET allows local code execution. Memory corruption within the core runtime environment poses significant risks to application integrity and system stability.
items.reason_zh: .NET中存在越界写入漏洞，可导致本地代码执行。核心运行时环境内的内存损坏对应用程序完整性和系统稳定性构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in .NET allows local privilege escalation. Arithmetic logic errors in framework libraries can be leveraged to bypass security boundaries and corrupt memory structures.
items.reason_zh: .NET中存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。框架库中的算术逻辑错误可被利用以突破安全边界并破坏内存结构。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in PowerShell allows authorized users to execute arbitrary commands locally, bypassing security controls and enabling script-based malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许授权用户在本地执行任意命令，绕过安全控制并实现基于脚本的恶意软件投递。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to execute malicious scripts over the network during development workflows, compromising IDE integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中存在代码注入漏洞，攻击者可在开发工作流期间通过网络执行恶意脚本，破坏IDE完整性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET framework permits local privilege escalation through malformed managed code execution, affecting widespread enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET框架中存在整数溢出漏洞，可通过执行畸形托管代码实现本地权限提升，影响广泛的企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Excel allows attackers to execute code locally by opening specially crafted documents, maintaining a persistent vector for macro-free malware.
items.reason_zh: Excel中存在不受信任的指针解引用漏洞，攻击者可通过打开特制文档在本地执行代码，为无宏恶意软件提供持续的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file access in Mistral Vibe bypasses workspace restrictions through unvalidated commands, exposing sensitive project files to unauthorized reading.
items.reason_zh: Mistral Vibe中存在任意文件访问漏洞，通过未经验证的命令绕过工作区限制，将敏感项目文件暴露给未授权读取。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary code execution in Mistral Vibe circumvents command permission checks via environment variable manipulation, allowing attackers to run unrestricted scripts.
items.reason_zh: Mistral Vibe中存在任意代码执行漏洞，通过操纵环境变量绕过命令权限检查，允许攻击者运行不受限制的脚本。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Pardus Boot Repair utilities allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, compromising Linux distribution maintenance tools.
items.reason_zh: Pardus Boot Repair实用工具中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者执行任意系统命令，危及Linux发行版维护工具。

items.reason_en: Shell metacharacter injection in projen configuration files enables context-dependent command execution on developer workstations and CI runners.
items.reason_zh: projen配置文件中存在Shell元字符注入漏洞，可在开发工作站和CI运行环境中实现上下文相关命令执行。

items.reason_en: Velociraptor lacks permission checks for certain client monitoring artifacts, allowing any user to schedule arbitrary command execution on endpoints, severely undermining EDR controls.
items.reason_zh: Velociraptor缺乏对某些客户端监控工件的权限检查，允许任何用户调度在端点上执行任意命令，严重削弱EDR控制能力。

items.reason_en: knowns-dev unconditionally exempts project configuration actions from permission guards, enabling read-only agents to bypass restrictions and gain write access.
items.reason_zh: knowns-dev无条件豁免项目配置操作的权限防护机制，使只读代理能够绕过限制并获得写入权限。

items.reason_en: Symlink traversal in Linux attr utilities allows local attackers to escalate privileges by replacing directory components with symbolic links during file operations.
items.reason_zh: Linux attr 工具存在符号链接遍历漏洞，本地攻击者可在文件操作过程中利用该漏洞，通过将目录组件替换为符号链接实现权限提升。
